tools.name: purge_failed_runs
tools.description: Deletes all runs in an experiment that are marked FAILED and older than a given number of days, removing their metric rows and artifact folders from the tracking store. Returns the list of deleted run ids after reading them from the database.

params.name: experiment_id
params.description: Experiment whose failed runs should be purged

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Only purge runs that ended more than this many days ago

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "mlruns/tracking.db"
ARTIFACT_ROOT = Path("mlruns/artifacts")


@tool
def purge_failed_runs(experiment_id: int, older_than_days: int) -> dict:
    cutoff_ms = int((time.time() - older_than_days * 86400) * 1000)
    deleted_ids = []
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT run_uuid FROM runs WHERE experiment_id = ? AND status = 'FAILED' AND end_time < ?",
                (experiment_id, cutoff_ms),
            ).fetchall()
            for (run_id,) in rows:
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM metrics WHERE run_uuid = ?", (run_id,))
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM params WHERE run_uuid = ?", (run_id,))
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE run_uuid = ?", (run_id,))
                deleted_ids.append(run_id)
    for run_id in deleted_ids:
        run_dir = ARTIFACT_ROOT / str(experiment_id) / run_id
        if run_dir.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(run_dir)
    return {"deleted_count": len(deleted_ids), "deleted_run_ids": deleted_ids}

tools.name: archive_run_artifacts_to_bucket
tools.description: Moves a run's local artifact folder into an archive directory, uploads the archived files to an S3 bucket, and records the archive location in the run's tags.

params.name: run_id
params.description: Id of the run to archive

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import boto3

TRACKING_DATABASE_PATH = "mlruns/tracking.db"
LIVE_ARTIFACT_DIRECTORY = Path("mlruns/artifacts")
ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY = Path("mlruns/archive")


def archive_run_artifacts_to_bucket(run_id: str, bucket_name: str) -> dict:
    source_directory_for_run = LIVE_ARTIFACT_DIRECTORY / run_id
    if not source_directory_for_run.is_dir():
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"No artifacts found for run {run_id}"}

    ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archived_directory_for_run = ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY / run_id
    shutil.move(str(source_directory_for_run), str(archived_directory_for_run))

    s3_client_for_upload = boto3.client("s3")
    uploaded_object_keys = []
    for each_file_path in archived_directory_for_run.rglob("*"):
        if each_file_path.is_file():
            relative_path_inside_run = each_file_path.relative_to(archived_directory_for_run).as_posix()
            destination_object_key = f"archive/{run_id}/{relative_path_inside_run}"
            s3_client_for_upload.upload_file(str(each_file_path), bucket_name, destination_object_key)
            uploaded_object_keys.append(destination_object_key)

    archive_location_uri = f"s3://{bucket_name}/archive/{run_id}/"
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(TRACKING_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        with database_connection:
            database_connection.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tags (run_uuid, key, value) VALUES (?, 'archive_uri', ?)",
                (run_id, archive_location_uri),
            )
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    return {"status": "ok", "archive_uri": archive_location_uri, "files_uploaded": len(uploaded_object_keys)}

tools.name: tag_best_run_in_experiment
tools.description: Finds the run with the best value for a metric in an experiment and writes a 'best_run' tag on it. Returns the winning run id and metric value.

params.name: metric_key
params.description: Metric name to rank runs by
